Archiving the Web

Over time the collection becomes a searchable memory, a place where half remembered ideas can be found again with a few keywords. The trick is to extract the readable text and discard the navigation menus, cookie banners, and footer links that surround every article. Once the text is clean it can be indexed for full text search and handed to assistants that help summarize and connect related notes.
